newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BELGIAN PARLIAMENTARY COMMISSION TO MEET AT 1800.
newsitem.headline: BELGIAN PARLIAMENTARY COMMISSION TO MEET AT 1800.

text.p: A special Belgian parliamentary commission will meet at 1800 (1700 GMT) to study a report from the Cour de Cassation on allegations that Deputy Prime Minister Elio Di Rupo had sex with under-age boys, Parliament President Raymond Langendries told reporters on Monday.
"Today we will have a first discussion about the report from the prosecutor general at the Cour de Cassation," Langendries said after a meeting with the leaders of the parliamentary parties.
He added that he expected the meeting to be short and to be followed by a statement.
Langendries said the court had raised a procedural problem with regard to the additional information about the Di Rupo case handed to it last Wednesday. He gave no details.

The commission -- and ultimately the whole parliament -- must decide if the allegations, totally unconnected with the discovery three months ago of the bodies of four sexually-abused young girls, are serious enough for Di Rupo to be indicted.

Di Rupo, a francophone socialist and discreet homosexual, denies the allegations. But they have further undermined public confidence in a political and legal system widely seen as thoroughly corrupt. -- Brussels Newsroom +32 2 287 6810
